User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Gaupro platform.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

phone.description: The phone number of the user.

isProfessional.description: Indicates whether the user is a professional service provider.

ProfessionalProfile.title: ProfessionalProfile
ProfessionalProfile.description: Represents the profile of a professional service provider.

id.description: Unique identifier for the professional profile.

companyName.description: The name of the professional's company.

description.description: A description of the professional's services and experience.

servicesOffered.description: A list of services offered by the professional.

certifications.description: A list of certifications held by the professional.

averageRating.description: The average rating of the professional (e.g., 1-5 stars).

ServiceRequest.title: ServiceRequest
ServiceRequest.description: Represents a service request submitted by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the service request.

category.description: The category of service requested (e.g., Plumbing, Electrical).

description.description: A detailed description of the service needed.

location.description: The location where the service is needed.

dateNeeded.description: The date the service is needed.

status.description: The current status of the service request (e.g., Open, Quoted, In Progress, Completed).

Quote.title: Quote
Quote.description: Represents a quote provided by a professional for a service request.

amount.description: The quoted amount for the service.

description.description: A description of the quote, including what is included.

dateCreated.description: The date the quote was created.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Represents a review of a professional's service by a user.

rating.description: The rating given by the user (e.g., 1-5 stars).

comment.description: The user's comments about the service.

dateCreated.description: The date the review was created.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the Gaupro application's core features, including user profiles, professional profiles, service requests, quotes, and reviews, while prioritizing security and scalability. It implements Authorization Independence by denormalizing authorization data where necessary, ensuring that rules can be evaluated without complex `get()` operations. Structural Segregation is used to maintain a homogeneous security posture within each collection. Access Modeling follows consistent patterns, leveraging path-based ownership and membership maps for collaborative data.

Users and Professional Profiles are stored in separate collections to allow for distinct security rules and scalability. Service Requests are stored as subcollections of Users, enabling easy retrieval of a user's requests. Quotes are nested under Service Requests and professional profile, allowing filtering by professional or by service request. Reviews are also stored as subcollections of both Service Requests and Professional Profiles enabling easy aggregation and filtering for reviews.

The design ensures QAPs by:

*   Segregating user-owned data (Service Requests) under `/users/{userId}`.
*   Using path-based ownership for user data.
*   Storing Professional Profiles separately to allow public listing while maintaining secure access to profile details.
